text: The package ran tamper.js, which wrote to the global npm toolchain file node-gyp/bin/node-gyp.js outside its own directory. Modifying node-gyp matters because that script runs during native module builds, so a tampered copy could alter or inject behavior into later installs on the machine. No network destinations were recorded, so this is a local toolchain modification rather than an observed download. The reviewer should not merge this package, should read tamper.js to see what it changed, and should restore or reinstall node-gyp from a trusted source on any machine where it ran.
